verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Entra exposes the directory through the Microsoft Graph REST API at a single endpoint (https://graph.microsoft.com), with a documented 'list users' operation. SCIM docs mention user and group provisioning, but that API runs between Entra and external apps, not as a directory management API. The evidence covers the user-API core, but the pagination, filtering, auth and app-assignment parts of the story are unshown. Missing for 10: documented group and app-role assignment endpoints, pagination and filtering semantics, auth/permission model details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
